title: Quantifying and Mitigating Socially Desirable Responding in LLMs: A Desirability-Matched Graded Forced-Choice Psychometric Study

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the shift in Item Response Theory (IRT)-estimated latent trait scores when language models are given 'HONEST' versus 'FAKE-GOOD' instruction prompts on personality questionnaires, and evaluating the mitigation of this response bias using a desirability-matched graded forced-choice (GFC) format.
